meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 模拟多个不同专业背景和性格的AI智能体开会讨论，按开场、自由讨论、辩论、共识、决策五阶段进行，最后输出包含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当用户需要从多个角度分析问题、需要不同领域的专业知识碰撞、需要模拟团队决策讨论时触发；典型场景如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

say.text: 请模拟一场会议，讨论我们是否采用微服务架构
say.note: 会生成多角色辩论和最终建议

say.text: 开个产品定价策略会，帮我评估三种定价方案
say.note: 产出市场分析、方案对比和收益评估

say.text: 组织项目风险评估会议，识别主要风险并给出应对措施
say.note: 输出风险清单和应对建议

howto.what_en: Simulates a meeting of multiple AI agents with different professional backgrounds and personalities, proceeding through opening, discussion, debate, consensus, and decision phases, then produces a meeting record with conclusions, key arguments, risks, and follow-up actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need multi-perspective analysis, cross-domain expertise, or simulated team decision-making, such as in project decisions, technical reviews, or business strategy planning.

say_en.text: Please simulate a meeting to discuss whether we should adopt microservices architecture.
say_en.note: Generates role-based debate and final recommendation.

say_en.text: Hold a product pricing strategy meeting to evaluate three pricing options.
say_en.note: Produces market analysis, option comparison, and revenue assessment.

say_en.text: Organize a project risk assessment meeting to identify key risks and propose countermeasures.
say_en.note: Outputs a risk checklist and response suggestions.
